report:
Reviewed the full fixtures claim including both code examples and grammar paragraphs, all eight implementation entries, and all thirteen associated tests. Requirements: exactly one source/files input; anonymous source and fixed named root src/lib.rs; source expressions and literal file paths; comma/trailing-comma/field-order rules; duplicate/unknown field rejection; relative implied directories; actual Rust module reachability with ambiguity and explicit-path handling; reserved project files and invalid path/conflict rejection; and rejection of annotations outside the selected crate.

compile_test! expands the file-map literal keys and arbitrary source expressions into setters, recursively accepting arbitrary field order and optional trailing commas. Unknown fields are rejected as nonexistent methods. source delegates to files with src/lib.rs, setters reject duplicates, and prepare rejects absent source. validate_files rejects missing fixed root, duplicate paths, absolute/backslash/empty/dot/parent components, reserved Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/build.rs/.cargo paths, and file/directory prefix conflicts before materialization. Parent directories are created from validated keys. The harness writes its own manifest with an isolated workspace and then uses that root for both compilers; rustc names src/lib.rs explicitly. Captured metadata loading chooses the ordinary library target from this generated manifest, not a caller root option.

SageHost collects textual fixture files, including non-rs files and files outside src with logical relative paths, but registration is not compilation. The local module walker begins at the selected root and follows expanded module symbols only. Its reached-file set is checked against every annotation, including compiler-specific markers. parse_mod separately stores inline module children and resolves file-backed declarations through module directories. resolve_mod_file requires exactly one of child.rs and child/mod.rs; explicit path bypasses the implicit search. Inline directory/path overrides and normalized logical parent components are preserved. This allows a source-level #[path = ../other.rs] to reach a fixture file while still forbidding parent traversal in the file-map key. parse/attrs recognizes supported path attributes. The recent change to symbol_local_item visibility does not alter any loading or reachability path.

Test evidence covers all the grammar branches: source_expressions_field_order_and_optional_trailing_commas uses indoc/raw/String expressions, reordered fields and named nested paths without trailing commas; source_selection_and_duplicate_fields_are_rejected asserts specific failures for absence, duplicate source/files combinations, edition and every expectation field. unknown_field_and_root_selection_fail_to_compile checks actual offline compilation reports the nonexistent method for both an arbitrary field and root, so failure cannot be satisfied by unrelated compiler errors. rejects_ambiguous_or_escaping_files enumerates reserved files, absent root, duplicates, traversal, absolute paths and file/directory conflict. unused_file_annotations_fail requires outside-selected-crate failure for a rustc-only marker. modules_and_associated_bodies observes a reached nested file. The ambiguous implicit-module test requires rejection, and the explicit-path control selects one file while an invalid body in the other remains uncompiled. Four review_fixture tests require non-rs loading, loading outside src, inline-directory resolution and explicit inline path overrides; rustc warning markers make the selected file observable. The additional inline-path test snapshots a selected nested expression. No TODO/N/A evidence is present.

Executed cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test fixture_grammar --test observation_review_fixtures --test review_fixture: 3, 2 and 7 tests passed. Earlier unchanged-code runs in this review session passed the compile:: unit suite (38 tests, including both associated fixture unit tests) and compile_tests/review_semantics (14/8 tests, including the remaining two associated integration tests). No production changes were made. Captured metadata, parser-dispatch and annotation helper dependencies in addition to the initial evidence. No requested edits.
